key: KXAIRDROPPUMPFUN|Will PumpFun conduct an airdrop before Sep 1, 2025?|If PumpFun conducts an airdrop before Sep 1, 2025, then the market resolves to Yes. An airdrop is defined as the distribution of fungible tokens to multiple wallet addresses where recipients receive tokens without paying the full market value. This includes free distributions requiring only gas fees, distributions requiring donations less than 10% of market value, retroactive rewards, task-based distributions, and phased distributions where initial tokens are received before the deadline. Token sales where recipients pay 10% or more of market value, ICOs, IDOs, employee compensation, liquidity mining rewards, staking rewards, NFTs, non-transferable tokens, and unconverted points do not constitute airdrops. The airdrop must be conducted (tokens actually distributed) before the deadline, not merely announced.
reasoning: Multiple reliable sources confirm that PumpFun did not conduct an airdrop before September 1, 2025. Although the platform announced on July 9, 2025 that an airdrop was "coming soon," COO Alon Cohen immediately clarified the next day that it would not happen in the "immediate future." No actual airdrop distributions took place before the September 1, 2025 deadline. The only PUMP token distributions to users occurred later in December 2025 (to PADRE holders) and April 2026 (token burns). The resolution criteria explicitly requires the airdrop to be "conducted (tokens actually distributed) before the deadline, not merely announced." Since this condition was not met, the market resolves to NO.
